headline: A drifting game where your EV battery is your health bar
text:
A drifting game where your EV battery is your health bar. 🔋

Real weight transfer physics, regen braking & zombie bounties—packed in a single zero-dependency HTML file.

Zero install. 0.1s load:
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A fast-paced 6-second gameplay clip/GIF showing a tight weight-transfer slide around oncoming traffic, regen braking kick-in with the UI lighting up, and a quick biome crossfade from rain to snow.
